title: PIN pepper and lighter argon2 cost (ADR-0018)

cases.precondition: APP_ENV is production or demo, every other secret is valid
cases.steps: 1. Load config with PIN_PEPPER unset
cases.expected: Startup is refused and the error names PIN_PEPPER

cases.precondition: APP_ENV is dev or ci, PIN_PEPPER unset
cases.steps: 1. Load config
cases.expected: Config loads, a fixed 32 byte test pepper and key id p1 are used

cases.precondition: APP_ENV production
cases.steps: 1. Load config with a non base64 value, a 5 byte value, a bad key id (uppercase, 17 chars, empty after colon), a malformed PIN_PEPPER_OLD entry, an empty old id, a duplicate old id and an old id equal to the current id
cases.expected: Every one refuses startup, and no error text contains the secret value

cases.precondition: APP_ENV production, good 32 byte pepper
cases.steps: 1. Load config with PIN_PEPPER_ID=p2 and PIN_PEPPER_OLD=p1:<base64>
cases.expected: Config exposes current id p2 and one old key p1

cases.precondition: APP_ENV production
cases.steps: 1. Set PIN_PEPPER to the fixed dev and ci test value
cases.expected: Startup is refused: the public test value cannot protect production PINs

cases.precondition: A pepper set with current id p1
cases.steps: 1. Hash PIN 482915  2. Verify 482915
cases.expected: Hash has the form $argon2id$v=19$m=19456,t=2,p=1,k=p1$salt$hash, verifies, needs no rehash, and two hashes of one PIN differ

cases.precondition: A hash made under pepper A id p1
cases.steps: 1. Verify a wrong PIN  2. Verify with pepper B under id p1  3. Verify with pepper A under id p9
cases.data: wrong PIN, wrong pepper, wrong key id
cases.expected: All three fail

cases.precondition: none
cases.steps: 1. Parse a hash with k=p1  2. Parse a hash with an unknown, a duplicate, a missing and a misordered field, a wrong version, a bad key id, bad base64
cases.expected: k= is accepted; every other shape is refused

cases.precondition: none
cases.steps: 1. Parse hashes at the bounds (m 131072, t 8, p 8) and one step above each, m below 8p, zero values, absurd salt and hash lengths
cases.expected: Values at the bound parse, anything above or below is refused and nothing is allocated

cases.precondition: A legacy hash made by HashPassword (m=65536, t=3, p=2, no k)
cases.steps: 1. Verify the right PIN  2. Verify a wrong PIN
cases.expected: Right PIN verifies on the raw PIN and asks for a rehash; wrong PIN fails

cases.precondition: none
cases.steps: 1. Compute the HMAC input for all 1,000,000 PIN strings
cases.expected: No two outputs are equal and none equals the raw PIN bytes

cases.precondition: none
cases.steps: 1. Run the dummy derivation and count derivations and the semaphore peak
cases.expected: Exactly one derivation with m=19456, t=2, p=1 goes through deriveKey

cases.precondition: A hash under key id p0 that is not configured
cases.steps: 1. Verify the right PIN
cases.expected: Fails with an unknown key id error carrying only the id, no panic

cases.precondition: Current id p2, old key p1, parameters m=19456, t=2, p=1
cases.steps: 1. Check the rehash decision for a legacy hash, a k=p1 hash, a k=p2 hash with older parameters and a fully current hash
cases.expected: Rehash is wanted for the first three and not for the last

cases.precondition: A service with no pepper
cases.steps: 1. Hash a PIN  2. Verify a hash
cases.expected: Both fail closed with ErrPepperNotConfigured

cases.precondition: A peppered PIN hash
cases.steps: 1. Pass it to VerifyPassword with the PIN and with the HMAC hex
cases.expected: Refused as malformed: a PIN hash is never checked through the password path

cases.precondition: A user whose pin_hash is a legacy hash
cases.steps: 1. VerifyPIN with the right PIN  2. Read pin_hash  3. VerifyPIN again
cases.expected: The first call succeeds and the row now holds a k=p1 hash in the same request; the second call succeeds without another rewrite

cases.precondition: A user with a legacy hash
cases.steps: 1. VerifyPIN with a wrong PIN  2. Read pin_hash
cases.expected: ErrPINIncorrect, counter incremented, hash byte-for-byte unchanged

cases.precondition: A user with a legacy hash
cases.steps: 1. Run 8 VerifyPIN calls in parallel with the right PIN  2. Read the row  3. Verify again
cases.expected: All succeed, the row holds one valid new-format hash and verifies

cases.precondition: A rehash computed from a legacy hash, and the PIN changed before the UPDATE
cases.steps: 1. Read the legacy hash  2. Change the PIN  3. Apply the late rehash
cases.expected: The late rehash affects 0 rows and the new PIN stays; a reset in between behaves the same

cases.precondition: A trigger makes every UPDATE of this user's pin_hash to a k= value fail
cases.steps: 1. VerifyPIN with the right PIN on a legacy hash
cases.expected: VerifyPIN returns nil (the payment is not failed), the legacy hash is still there and still verifies

cases.precondition: A user with a password
cases.steps: 1. SetPIN  2. ChangePIN  3. Reset a PIN with a one-time code  4. Use testkit.SetPIN
cases.expected: After each, pin_hash has the k=<current id> format and m=19456,t=2,p=1

cases.precondition: A hash made under p1
cases.steps: 1. Rotate: current p2, p1 in the old list  2. VerifyPIN  3. Read the row
cases.expected: Verification succeeds and the row now carries k=p2

cases.precondition: A hash under p1 that was never migrated; p1 removed from the config
cases.steps: 1. VerifyPIN with the right PIN  2. Run the PIN reset flow  3. VerifyPIN with the new PIN
cases.expected: Step 1 returns ErrPINIncorrect (same answer as a wrong PIN, no panic), step 2 works, step 3 succeeds and the row is k=p2

cases.precondition: A user with a stored new-format hash for a known PIN
cases.steps: 1. Copy pin_hash  2. Try the known PIN with a wrong pepper and with no pepper (raw PIN as legacy)
cases.expected: Neither verifies

cases.precondition: A service with a capturing log handler at debug level
cases.steps: 1. Set a PIN, verify right and wrong, rehash a legacy hash, rotate, hit a retired key  2. Read the captured log, the returned errors and all audit_logs rows of the user
cases.data: PIN, pepper bytes (raw, base64, hex), HMAC of the PIN (raw, base64, hex)
cases.expected: None of those strings appears anywhere

cases.precondition: A user without a PIN and an unknown user id
cases.steps: 1. VerifyPIN for each and count derivations
cases.expected: ErrPINNotSet for both, each spent one derivation

cases.precondition: none
cases.steps: 1. Run many PIN hashes and verifies in parallel and read the peak
cases.expected: Peak concurrent derivations never exceeds the CPU count

cases.precondition: A database with users in both formats
cases.steps: 1. Run the count query from docs/runbooks/pin-pepper.md in psql
cases.expected: One row per key id plus legacy and no-PIN rows; the counts add up to the user count

cases.precondition: A fresh migrated database, 4 CPU container
cases.steps: 1. Run the load test with LOAD_USERS=200 LOAD_WORKERS=50 LOAD_SECONDS=60 TEST_DB_MAX_CONNS=40 before and after
cases.expected: Both runs recorded in the performance note with the laptop caveat, 0 ledger mismatches
